description: The sound of wagon on the pavement. The recording was realized in the National Museum of Agriculture and Agricultural-Food Industry in Szreniawa (Poland). Wooden wagons were used for collecting straw and hay from the field as well as for transporting people. The wheels were wooden, handmade by a wheelwright. They were often powered by oxen.
